description: The roster-aware revision: the org's agent roster is rendered into the body via {{agent_roster}}, the addressing rule is stated against that roster (a name on it is an agent, a name off it is a person), and triage_officer is restated to cover ticket/task intake. Scores the fix for 'agent, file a ticket for X' landing off_topic.
not_measurable_yet: No cassette for THIS body. `cassettes/agent_roster_20260831.jsonl` holds the model's answers to the 08-31 prompt and is keyed on the rendered prompt, so it cannot be replayed here — it is pinned to `agent_roster_20260831` instead, which is the arm `delegation_probe_test.exs` scores. Record this arm the moment an endpoint is reachable: `mix platform.intent_eval.run --config agent_roster --record`. Same reasoning as `unmerged_intent_target.json`.
prompt_provenance: Byte-identical copy (8964 bytes, sha256 9f05df840bb9d2bd522c5df4169aec70be5dfbb8435a17d5753432cdf97fb416, after task 01a14dce replaced one exemplar line with an invented one) of the @new_content heredoc in apps/platform/priv/repo/migrations/20260911030000_force_update_intent_classify_prompt_agent_roster_on_unmerged.exs. Copied rather than referenced with a {"migration": ..} source for the same reason off_topic_default.json copies its body: a config whose prompt source only resolves on somebody else's checkout is exactly the unattributable run this harness exists to end. force_update_intent_classify_prompt_agent_roster_drift_test.exs guards the two copies against divergence.
agent_roster_provenance: The PRODUCTION roster as of 2026-08-31, read from role_assignments JOIN agents on the production install (`select ra.role_key, a.slug, a.name from role_assignments ra join agents a on a.id = ra.agent_id order by 1`) and rendered through Platform.Meetings.IntentClassifier.format_agent_roster/1 — the same formatter the runtime uses, so the harness scores the block production sends. Pinned as data rather than looked up live because a run whose prompt depends on the caller's database reproduces a different number on every box.
